title: Universe lifting preserves adic formal smoothness
statement: Let R : Type u and S : Type v be commutative rings, with S an R-algebra, and n an ideal of S. Suppose S is formally smooth over R for the n-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], with test algebras in universe max u v. For any universe w, the canonical R-algebra ULift.{w} S is formally smooth for the ideal obtained by mapping n under the inverse of ULift.down, with test algebras in universe max u v w. No Noetherian, local, complete, or nontrivial hypotheses are needed.

source.place: Definition 15.38.1 (07EB) and Definition 15.38.3 (07NI); universe bookkeeping for Lemma 07NR and Remark 07NS, proved by T2.

proof.text: For a test map g:ULift S→D/J, choose representatives r(s) in D of g(up s). Evaluate P=R[X_s | s∈S] in D at these representatives and put T=P/ker(q). The induced algebra map i:T→D is injective and T lies in universe max u v.

Put K=i⁻¹(J). Injectivity of i and J²=0 imply K²=0. The induced map j:T/K→D/J is injective. Send s∈S to the class of X_s in T/K; its j-image is g(up s), so j-injectivity verifies all ring and scalar relations. This defines g′:S→T/K. Ideal map commutes with powers, so g′ kills the same positive power of n.

Apply the original formally smooth adic lifting property [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic] to T,K,g′. Compose the lift with i and ULift.down. Applying j to the original lift equation proves the desired equation into D/J.

proof_origin.place: Universe bookkeeping written by T2 using the lifting definition; the small algebra is a polynomial evaluation quotient.
